from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document from the collection: its title and cause of action."""
    index: int = Field(description="The order this document appears in the collection (0-indexed)")
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) as stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g., 判决书, 裁定书, 行政判决书)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
